svg.title: Harvest now, decrypt later
svg.desc: Mosca's inequality x + y > z: x is how long data must stay secret, y how long migration takes, z the time until a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. An attacker records ciphertext now and decrypts it after z. Timeline: FIPS 203, 204 and 205 published August 2024; this demo run 2026-10-12; NIST IR 8547 deprecates 112-bit quantum-vulnerable algorithms after 2030 and disallows quantum-vulnerable algorithms after 2035.
